Hi! My name is Alyssa and I’d love to invite you to try TurboJot. I actually founded the company. It’s built to automate contact form submissions at scale. Simply upload a list of URLs and TurboJot automatically finds and submits contact forms on those sites. It beats cold email and paid ads on ROI and costs just $0.10 per submission. Powered by a rotating IP network, stealth browser, AI captcha solving, and human-like browsing behavior. You can sign up for free and give it a try here. I’d really appreciate the support! https://www.turbojot.com/
